quests.label: Regular sleep window
quests.description: Log at least 5 nights with 7 h or more of sleep this week.
quests.safetyNote: Credit is for enough sleep, never for less.

quests.label: Countermeasure minutes
quests.description: Complete 300 minutes of countermeasure exercise this week.
quests.safetyNote: Exercise credit is capped at 90 minutes a day to keep things healthy.

quests.label: Measure on time
quests.description: Complete 5 scheduled measurements on time this week.

quests.label: Shielding drill
quests.description: Read the radiation-event procedure and walk through it once.

badges.label: First Baseline
badges.criteria: Any indicator finishes learning your normal.

badges.label: Steady Sleeper
badges.criteria: 14 nights of 7 h+ sleep within the last 21 days.

badges.label: Full Mission Log
badges.criteria: Check-ins on 90% of mission days after at least 30 days.
